exposure: Trial of labor (TOL) with twin gestation
Twin B delivered by cesarean section
non-cephalic twin B after delivery of twin A
cohort: 221 women who underwent TOL and delivered twin A vaginally
finding: Non-cephalic presentation of twin B at admission or after delivery of twin A significantly increased the risk of combined twin delivery.
mod_finding: Combined delivery was associated with a slightly higher risk of hemorrhagic-ischemic encephalopathy in twin B.
